verdict.rationale: The probe found no downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger spec: every candidate path returned 404. The only machine-friendly artifacts in evidence are markdown API reference pages (e.g. POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve) and an llms.txt index, which are documentation rather than a formal API spec. Confidence is medium because the probe checked only a fixed set of URLs on docs.stripe.com, so a spec published elsewhere would not have been found.
